scope: Moved-block detection and native two/combined-pane markers, tooltips, block navigation, editing/history, saved View toggle/reload ownership, original artwork, Help and CI
source: MovedBlocks.cpp unique groups, left/right extension and mutable interval/extension-list bookkeeping; special whitespace keys, seed-zero and final NoEnding boundaries retained.

DiffData::TieMovedBlocks and BaseView margin tooltip/double-click whole counterpart selection.
implementation: Detector runs off UI thread on the authoritative Subversion plan with cancellation; original source records and alignment remain unchanged.
Byte-exact upstream moved.ico with provenance, colored margin icons, row tooltip regions including wrapped fragments and move margin when numbers are hidden.
Two-pane bidirectional focus/whole-block linked centering and combined original/added occurrence mapping; keyboard-accessible native context command with captured generation.

In-place edits retain surviving move records, remap peers across inserted rows, omit new/deleted records and split target selection at unmarked rows. Matching history snapshot owns links and Undo/Redo.

limits: The source oracle adapts platform containers/string storage; it does not prove full Windows dialog/rendering equivalence.
